_doc: Local (kind) probe of the second suspicious remote pattern: wal throughput NOT scaling with the CPU pin (47k@4vCPU vs 43k@8vCPU remotely — fsync-lane/commit-path bound at ~25-30% CPU). Same client model as write-cliff-local but the server gets 4 vCPUs and 4 wal shards; compare against write-cliff-local's 2-vCPU wal cells at the same stream counts. If wal stays flat 2->4 vCPU locally too, the commit-path investigation can iterate on a laptop.
